ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution with approximately 85% high-intensity (white) central surface area bounded by 15% low-intensity (black/dark grey) peripheral margins and focal spots.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant contiguous white central region. Left lobe contains a cluster of 5-7 small dark elliptical spots near the tip. Right lobe features a complex arrangement of circular rings, linear streaks, and irregular black blotches concentrated toward the distal half and along the trailing edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Distinct V-shaped notch with an approximate 85-degree internal angle and sharp vertex transition.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the entire trailing edge; pixel-amplitude of peaks is most pronounced on the outer thirds of each lobe, reaching 15-20 pixel depth.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave leading-edge profile with an upward-sweeping convex trajectory on the trailing edge towards the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and annular dark pixel clusters observed on the right lobe; at least four distinct ring-shaped patterns consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct dark linear pixel disruptions visible on the right lobe: one vertical mark approximately 15% of the lobe height and two shorter diagonal marks near the trailing edge.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive calcified barnacle colonization (Coronula diadema) present at both distal tips, creating significant pixel-density protrusions and irregular edge geometry.
other_distinctive_markers: A singular, large dark circular ring-scar located in the lower-quadrant of the right lobe, distinct from the smaller mottling spots.
